places.description: Yorkville is a village in Oneida County in central New York. It covers about 0.7 square miles of land, and about 2,572 people live there (Census Bureau estimate for July 1, 2025).

places.name: Youngstown
places.description: Youngstown is a village in Niagara County in western New York. It covers about 1.1 square miles of land and 0.2 square miles of water, and about 1,822 people live there (Census Bureau estimate for July 1, 2025).

places.name: Zena
places.description: Zena is a community in Ulster County in southeastern New York that the Census Bureau counts as a place but that has no city or town government of its own. It covers about 3.1 square miles of land, and 1,038 people lived there at the 2020 Census.
